stem.en: A village has just drawn its representatives from the pot. What happens to them next, according to the Uttaramerur inscription?

text.en: They are divided into specialised committees, such as those for irrigation, justice and taxes.
They travel to the capital to serve the king.
They are drawn again every week until one leader is left.
They choose one of their number to be the village's new king.

explanation.en: The elected members were divided into specialised committees called variyams. Each was given important village work, such as managing irrigation (the tank committee), administering justice and collecting taxes.

hints.en: The chosen people stay in the village and do its work.
